description: Chantiers du Département à l'étude et en travaux sur la voirie de Boulogne-Billancourt is a dataset listed in Boulogne-Billancourt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Carte des chantiers du Département à l’étude et en travaux sur la voirie départementale. Ce jeu de données répertorie les projets portés par le Département des Hauts-de-Seine, principalement sur ses emprises. Ces projets peuvent être des travaux en cours ou bien des études avancées qui déboucheront ultérieurement sur des chantiers. Coverage: Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are transports, travaux, voirie, routes départementales, RD, projets. The portal shows 10 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boulognebillancourt-seineouest-portal.
